name: career-map
description: A read-only canvas of an employee's career plan — role cards joined by colour-coded company Career Path lines and dashed Career vision lines, laid out left to right.

properties.value: The map is a group with the consumer's aria-label (e.g. "Lan Nguyen's career map").

Every card is focusable with Tab and announces its state, Position and level ("Active target: Backend Engineer, L3 · Senior"). Enter or Space selects it; the description says so. Delete does nothing — the map is read-only.

Company paths are told apart by colour and named in CareerMapLegend; Career vision is dashed (not colour alone). The target card has a border and a text label, not colour alone. Path and vision lines are at least 3:1 against the canvas.

Opening view never shrinks cards below 80% zoom so text stays readable. When the whole map doesn't fit at that zoom, it opens on the current role and its next steps; "Show whole map" zooms out. Page scroll is never captured — scroll-to-zoom is off.
Zoom out, Zoom in and Show whole map are design-system Buttons with accessible names.
Freeform canvases are hard to use by keyboard and on phones. A list view of the same items is planned for My Career; until then every card is reachable by Tab.

constraints: Use only for an employee's career plan — role cards connected by moves. For an ordered, admin-edited path use career-path-stepper.
Pass items and links only; the component lays cards out left to right from the links. Never pass coordinates.
A link with pathId is a company Career Path move and takes that path's colour; a link without pathId is the employee's Career vision and is dashed.
Assign each company path a colour 1–3 and render CareerMapLegend with the same paths so colours are named.
Exactly one card should be in state current; at most one in state target.
The map is read-only: no dragging, connecting or deleting. Plan changes happen through Preview → Confirm outside the map.
Give the map a height from its container (it fills 100%).

doNot.wrong: Show progress or gap numbers on the cards
doNot.correct: Keep cards to state, Position and level; show progress and gaps in the page, fixed to the Active target

doNot.wrong: Use brand or blue for a company path line
doNot.correct: Use career-map/path-1..3 — brand means selected / primary and blue means info

doNot.wrong: Tell a Career vision apart by colour only
doNot.correct: Leave pathId off the link so it renders dashed, with a dashed card border

doNot.wrong: Open the map zoomed out until text is unreadable
doNot.correct: Let the component choose the opening view; offer Show whole map for the overview
Use the built-in zoom and Show whole map buttons

subComponents.name: career-map-legend
subComponents.role: Names each company path colour and the dashed Career vision
subComponents.overrideRule: Pass the same paths as the map

relatedComponents.name: career-path-stepper
relatedComponents.reason: Both show career moves; the stepper is an ordered admin list, the map is an employee's branching plan.

openQuestions: Path colours use chart/1–3 via career-map/path-*; hex values may change later.
List view fallback for keyboard and mobile is not built yet.
notes: Built on React Flow (@xyflow/react, MIT). Layout constants (card 192×88, column gap 64, row gap 32) are canvas coordinates, not CSS spacing.
knownIssues: React Flow's attribution link shows in the bottom-right corner.

changelog.change: Created Career Map, Career Map Legend and the career-map component-token collection for My Career.

notes: Controlled selection: pass selectedId and onSelect; click, Enter and Space all report through onSelect.
Opening view is computed from the layout (fixed card sizes) with setViewport — not fitView, whose options React Flow overwrites from props before cards are measured.

docs.intro:
# Career Map

A read-only canvas of an employee's career plan — role cards joined by colour-coded company Career Path lines and dashed Career vision lines, laid out left to right.

---

sections.title: Structure
sections.body:
```
CareerMap — group, fills its container; fill: career-map/canvas
├─ grid — two line layers: career-map/grid (fine) · career-map/grid-strong (wide)
├─ controls — top-right; inset spacing/component/md, gap spacing/component/xs
│  └─ Button ×3 — Zoom out · Zoom in · Show whole map
├─ CareerMapNode ×n — one per item, 192×88
│  ├─ state label — icon + text (You are here · Active target · Planned · Career vision)
│  ├─ title — Position name
│  └─ level — "L2 · Mid"
└─ connection ×n — curved line + arrowhead; path colour or dashed vision
CareerMapLegend — list below the map, one entry per company path + Your career vision
```

---

sections.title: Token Bindings
sections.body:
| Frame | Property | Token |
|---|---|---|
| Canvas | Fill | `career-map/canvas` |
| Canvas | Fine grid | `career-map/grid` |
| Canvas | Wide grid | `career-map/grid-strong` |
| Node | Fill | `career-map/node-surface` |
| Node | Border | `career-map/node-border` |
| Node — target | Border | `career-map/target-border` |
| Node — vision | Border (dashed) | `career-map/vision-border` |
| Node — selected / focus | Outline | `career-map/node-selected` |
| Node | Radius | `career-map/node-radius` |
| Node | Padding | `career-map/node-padding` |
| Node | Line gap | `career-map/node-gap` |
| Node | Title | `career-map/node-foreground` |
| Node | Level, Planned and Career vision labels | `career-map/node-description` |
| Node — current | Label | `career-map/current-label` |
| Node — target | Label | `career-map/target-label` |
| Connection — company path | Stroke + arrow | `career-map/path-1` · `career-map/path-2` · `career-map/path-3` |
| Connection — vision | Stroke + arrow (dashed) | `career-map/vision-edge` |
| Controls | Inset | `spacing/component/md` |
| Controls | Gap | `spacing/component/xs` |
| Legend | Text | `color/text/secondary` |
| Legend | Entry gap | `spacing/component/lg` · `spacing/component/xs` |

---

sections.title: Behavior
sections.body:
Read-only: cards can't be dragged, connected or deleted. Click, Enter or Space on a card calls `onSelect(id)`; the consumer controls `selectedId`. Cards are placed in columns by the longest chain of links reaching them and centred per column.

Opening view: the whole map if it fits at 80% zoom or more, otherwise the current role and its next steps. Zoom buttons step in and out; Show whole map zooms out to everything (down to 40%). Drag to pan; pinch to zoom; mouse-wheel scroll is left to the page.

---
